name: Darija-VLM-UBC-NLP-Henna-Bench-Eval
description: A vision-and-language benchmark focused on Moroccan Arabic (Darija) that evaluates VLMs on multimodal understanding and generation in a low-resource dialect. It contains image–text pairs and multimodal prompts designed to test caption generation, visual question answering, and image–text matching in Darija. The suite targets robustness of VLMs to dialectal language phenomena and limited training data.
general_score_metric: BLEU (for captioning tasks) / accuracy (for VQA tasks)
reputation: Niche, research-oriented benchmark mainly used by groups working on Arabic dialects and vision-language models; limited widespread adoption.
